mapper.select: SELECT limit_amount FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.base_price * s.sell_qty), 0) FROM sell_order s JOIN inbound_detail id ON s.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id JOIN inbound i ON id.inbound_id = i.inbound_id LEFT JOIN krw_exchange k ON k.order_id = s.order_id AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.status != 'REJECTED' AND k.exchange_id IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM krw_exchange WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND settlement_status = 'FINALIZED'
SELECT c.ci_hash FROM customer c JOIN account a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
